purpose: Make website-derived product naming visible, traceable, and available to the reviewed packet before any SuiteScript write path is enabled.
websiteFirstPackageRules: Website product/category evidence selects the package and product seed before conversation notes shape story copy.
Conversation notes can make the value story specific but cannot override a high-confidence website product family with cross-lane terminology.
New websites should prefer explicit product/category tokens in the website/domain/customer name before falling back to lane proof anchor names.
If the package source is medium or low confidence, mark N/LLM recommended and show exactly what needs verification.
W28 ordered passes are known domain, website category classifier, conversation-note product cue, industry fallback, then N/LLM advisory enrichment.
N/LLM may propose sharper names only when each suggestion carries website/category/source basis or an explicit inferred_from_website flag.

websitePackageClassifierV2.notesBoundary: Conversation notes drive pain, ROI, competitive positioning, objections, and live run coaching after the package is selected.

antiLeakRules: Do not use ingredient and lot readiness for Dealer Hardgoods unless the website proves a food, beverage, ingredient, or regulated lot-controlled product.
Do not name Apparel packages as branch inventory or industrial distribution when the website shows apparel, footwear, style, size, or color.
Do not leave proof items as Finished Good or Product / SKU when a website product family can produce a better product seed.

expectedRecords: Trek Bikes - dealer bicycle availability Demo Order
Trek Bikes Bicycle Dealer Hardgoods Inventory / Fulfillment

whenRecommended: productSeed is lane proof anchor only
conversation notes contain specific product or launch terms not captured by local rules
mustNot: invent product facts without marking them inferred
